shared_elements: horizontal band of closely repeated vertical/comb-like strokes spanning the width
curved hook- or head-like terminal at one end of a long horizontal form
small standing/striding figures placed above or beside the main band
repeated row of similar small units (tick marks, pendants)
justification: The most specific correspondence is a long horizontal element fringed with a dense row of short repeated strokes, with an isolated profile quadruped placed near it, which gives both images a comparable banded, register-like reading. Against this, the manner is wholly different: A is three-dimensional low relief in stone with modelled, overlapping animals and a rough, weathered surface, while B is a flat, uniform red painted silhouette on smooth rock with no modelling and a single dominant motif.
